evidence.note: Creates a structured 6-item task list spanning the major work families (numeric exec, calls, v128 helpers, SIMD decode/exec, validator), serving as a coverage checklist.
Counts non-validation fails per file — uses per-file failure breakdown to know which areas still fail, a fine-grained-ish coverage measure.
Extracts the actual SIMD sub-opcodes exercised by tests, scoping the huge opcode surface so it knows what must be covered.
Runs full score then 'Confirm all remaining are validation' — precisely characterizes the composition of the remaining gap to 1.0.
Marks tasks completed/in_progress as milestones close, keeping the checklist current across the long horizon.
Repeated full-score reconciliation after validator fixes down to a final confirmation, tracking the aggregate against remaining work.

reasoning: The agent keeps a checklist of work families and repeatedly reconciles it against aggregate scores and per-file failure counts, categorizing failures (validation vs runtime) and pinpointing the remaining gap (step 149) — clearly above the plain-checklist level 5. But the ledger is coarse (6 tasks, test-file granularity rather than an explicit per-opcode-family done/remaining/blocked ledger) and there is no evident detection of cross-family regressions or thrashing on a stuck assertion, keeping it below the level-8 anchor. This lands at a 6, interpolating between the 5 and 8 descriptions.
